Body **r155**, written 2026-10-09T01:39Z by `session_01JmWtcHfGbC4ncw4GFKWuRA` (os-elon-musk) at the R1 landing close-out (PR #22382 MERGED). r154 (the R1 collection), r153 (the R1 dispatch), r152 (seating) and r151 (the previous seat's vacant hand-off: its R1–R4 landing ledger, the observations it left for the maintainer and the platform readings it kept) are in the edit history, ⛔ not restated.

## Current PM

🟢 **os-elon-musk** — `session_01JmWtcHfGbC4ncw4GFKWuRA`, seated 2026-10-08T23:12Z on the maintainer's `/pm-dispatch skills`, on the release marker 6063242958 (the previous seat's 收班简报, `session_01CXydFDyiQwNbGFkmwrcRQq`, huangyiirene); round-open marker 6070895609. Wake-up: patrol Routine `trig_01Jfbu9bR4hQu3aRDMRehfJF` (hourly, self-bound) as the default wake-up; no accelerator, no check-in, no PR subscription (the one on PR #22382 retired at its merge). Served tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (`get_session` `last_served_model` equals the constant's value) ⇒ the in-seat contract review is at tier. Write identity: every write leaves through `scripts/pm/` as `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, route `dispatch` (relay `fleet-write.yml` on `main`, Actions `active`). Seat 2 (#19287) is ⏳ vacant. The lane's objectui board is objectstack-ai/objectui#11311 (one seat, two boards; r18 of this session).

## Inherited + running ledger

- **Maintainer's lift, read 2026-10-09T00:11Z in this session's chat, verbatim 「你可以派发」** — it answers the seat's in-session question on the 2026-10-07 hold 「创建卡片,暂时不派发。」 (#22052 · #22053 · #22060). **Recorded on the cards: not yet** — the session's auto-mode classifier refused the seat's relay writes for the three hold-lift comments and for the #22369 close (reason given: "External System Writes"), while the ordinary claim shape (label pair + `Claim:` comment) went through for #22372. Nothing is half-written on those four cards: no label moved, no comment posted. The seat has asked the maintainer for one of two remedies (a lift comment in their own hand on each card, which the cards' `Restart-when:` lines name directly, or a Bash permission rule for `scripts/pm/` writes); until one lands, #22052 · #22053 · #22060 stay `pm:on-hold` and #22369 stays `pm:queue`.
- **In flight 0. Landing window 0.**
- **Landed this round (R1), closed out:** PR #22382 (#22372, p2 `bug`, Tier H: `skills/objectstack-query/SKILL.md:65-70`, the `{ flowRunId }` clause rewritten to the D5-admitted shapes; +1 line within the +1 cap) merge `191543456f` MERGED 2026-10-09T01:35Z after `os-zhuang`'s APPROVED (5464598394) and their own ready flip, arming and enqueue (one queue entry ahead, 31 minutes in the queue) — the seat armed nothing; claim 6071728606, dev report 6072018592 (`mode:subagent`, `model: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, dispatch → draft PR 24 min), contract review PASS 6072073121 (in seat, at tier), ACCEPT 6072079471, brief 6072085576, landing note 6072501210; the card closed `completed` by `Fixes`, `pm:dispatched` and the assignee stripped, the PR's `needs-user-decision` stripped after the merge; MERGED proof taken (ancestor of `origin/main` with a control leg, changed lines identical to the head diff, `origin/main` carries the new sentence). The lane's open set 8 → 7. Planned next in this batch, once the lift is on the cards: **#22052** (p1, relay `pr_update_branch` op; branch `claude/issue-22052-relay-pr-update-branch-op`) and **#22053** (p2, the silent-claim reclaim protocol; branch `claude/issue-22053-silent-claim-reclaim`); their claim texts are prepared and file-disjoint from #22372.
- **Lane state at this write:** queue (`pm:queue` ∩ `domain:skills`) objectstack 0 · objectui 0; landing window 0; decision box 0; bare `finding` · `pm:retriage` 0; **`pm:awaiting-maintainer` 1 (#22369)** — the triage seat amended its own grade (6072053973): a `tooling` card without an admission line cannot queue, and option A (the relay's App token gains `actions: write` for one allowlisted `workflow_dispatch` op) loosens a security boundary, so the card carries `Maintainer-action:` asking the maintainer yes/no; triage's and this seat's reading is **No** (the one measured pull was answered by hand within hours; the `pm:awaiting-maintainer` + `Maintainer-action:` convention already covers run-only unblocks) — on No the seat closes it `not_planned`, on Yes it dispatches A with the allowlist and a self-test; the seat's earlier plan to close it from `pm:queue` is withdrawn; blocked 1 (#22167, `Blocked-by: #22060 (W3)`); on-hold 3 (#22052 · #22053 · #22060, lift pending as above). #22060's plan after the lift lands: W1 filed as the first `tooling` child (guarded surface on its first line) and dispatched next round; W2 and W3 filed as `needs-user-decision` cards for the director seat before any code; W4–W7 one per fire.
- **Inherited from r151, still standing (pointers, not restated):** the observations for the maintainer (the session classifier refusing an `os-dev` subagent's `label-write` in 3 of 4 cases; one dev commit authored under a non-fleet git identity; `post-stamped`'s size route beside the fleet-identity rule; the 2026-10-07 merge-queue head stall, a single occurrence); the cross-lane memos (#22290 is the spec seat's; #22172 still carries `pm:dispatched` as the director seat's close-out residue, ⛔ not this seat's to strip; closed #21959 · #21992 · #21929 still carry the assignee `os-steve`, harmless). The platform readings r151 kept belong in `references/platform-readings.md` through a skills PR when the lane has capacity, ⛔ not in this post.

## Notes

- **Job description and write paths.** `references/lanes/skills.md`; content writes only through `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` (`--repo=owner/name` with `=`; `--ack-through=ID` from the LAST comment page for a body refresh; every stamp is a NOW token or a declared WAS token, and a WAS later than the act's clock is refused) / `label-write.mjs` / `issue-create.mjs` / `close-cards.mjs` (`--stateless` after the state label is stripped; `--no-skip-pr-referenced` when a closed PR still references the card) and `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --actions-file` (`issue_patch`, `assign`, `pr_ready`, `pr_draft`, `automerge_enable`, `automerge_disable`, `pr_request_reviewers`). Route: `dispatch` (relay `fleet-write.yml` on `main`). ⛔ No MCP write. An accepted dispatch with no run is UNCONFIRMED (exit 6) — ⛔ never re-run blind; go read the card.
- **Landing.** Non-governed = CI all green + the seat's at-tier read, through the queue (`check-expected-skips --pr N` exit 0, `check-governed-merges --pr N`, relay `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`); arm only after `mergeable_state` reads `clean`. Tier S (`.claude/**`) = at-tier `## Contract review` PASS in seat, then the same flip. Tier H (`skills/**`, `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `docs/adr/**`) = the four-piece set (contract review on the PR, ACCEPT on the card, `needs-user-decision` + 维护者速读 on the PR, review requested from `os-zhuang` and `hotlong` via relay `pr_request_reviewers`), the PR waits draft; on an authorized APPROVED the seat lands unless the approver already did; close-out is the seat's either way. `check-expected-skips` can answer exit 3 while a check-run is still being created on the head — re-run a minute later.
- **Liveness baseline** (`mode:subagent`, carried from r151): dispatch → draft PR 25–31 min for one-file skill fixes at tier, 71 min for an `M` probe with a 30-family gate pass; a patch round 25 min; queue latency 24–85 min; the fleet write-pace budget is 40 writes per trailing hour per token; a container restart kills in-flight subagents but leaves worktrees, the shared checkout and the scratchpad — re-dispatch from the worktree, never commit its leftovers from the seat.
- **Classifier reading (this session):** the auto-mode classifier passed the seat's body refreshes, title/assignee flips, marker, comment edit and the #22372 claim pair, and refused the hold-lift comments and a close (even their `--dry-run`) — a reading on the classifier, not on the rule; recorded for the maintainer, not a card.
- **Timers and subscriptions:** patrol Routine `trig_01Jfbu9bR4hQu3aRDMRehfJF` (hourly, self-bound, created at seating). No accelerator; the two PR #22382 safety-net check-ins are spent (one fired, one deleted at the merge). No PR subscription.
- **Platform readings (this shift):** the approver's own ready + arm entered the queue 2.5 minutes later (`added_to_merge_queue` is the proof) and the entry waited 31 minutes for the one ahead of it — not a stall; a queue merge with `merge_method: merge` lands a two-parent merge commit, so the MERGED proof's "single parent" phrasing from earlier shifts applies only to squash landings; the session classifier passed every claim-shape, label and body write of this shift and refused the three hold-lift comments and a close.
